name: RPT - Google Sheet Lead Action Intake

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const action = String($json.Action ?? '').trim(); const status = String($json['Action Status'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(); const supported = ['Start cadence','Restart cadence','Do not contact','Booked']; if (!supported.includes(action)) return false; if (!status) return true; if (status.startsWith('processing:') || status.startsWith('retrying ')) return false; if (action === 'Restart cadence') return true; if (status === 'booked' || status === 'do not contact applied') return false; if (action === 'Start cadence') return !['cadence started','already in cadence','cadence completed'].includes(status); if (action === 'Do not contact') return status !== 'do not contact applied'; return status !== 'booked'; })() }}
